Alice (Support): customer Acme reports a spike of 502/504 during large-embeddings job, started ~2025-07-21T09:04:00Z. ticket #12345. x-request-id=r-93a1
Ben (Eng-SRE): grabbing traces / logs. can you paste a sample x-request-id and curl repro?
Alice (Support): sample id r-93a1. Repro curl I ran:
```
curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"model":"embed-xl","inputs":["item1", "item2", /* ... ~500 items ... */]}' \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings
```
Alice (Support): customer says failures are intermittent but sustained for 12 minutes, mostly 502s on streaming responses and some 504s.
Carla (Infra): I see matching edge logs: `2025-07-21T09:04:12Z edge-01 envoy error 502 upstream connection reset by peer r-93a1` and `upstream response timeout after 60000ms r-93a1` — looks like upstream backend is dropping or timing out under large payloads.
Dinesh (Eng): Which backend? hosted-embed-pool-3? I'll check instance metrics.
Ben (Eng-SRE): quick checklist: 1) check h2 stream counts per connection 2) connection pool saturation 3) backend pod OOM/GC 4) auth token rotation logs.
Ben (Eng-SRE): ran a grep: `rg \"r-93a1\" /var/log/edge/*.log` returned a bunch of `level=warn h2 pool exhausted stream_quota=0` entries on edge-01 and edge-02.
Carla (Infra): confirmed: edge h2 keepalive pool at 100% for 2 nodes. netstat shows lots of `CLOSE_WAIT` sockets from long-lived upload connections.
Alice (Support): customer is blocking rollout for a partner, very sensitive. any short-term mitigation?
Ben (Eng-SRE): mitigation: 1) apply rate-limit on embeddings endpoint for that tenant (soft-limit) 2) force-run a canary config: reduce `max_concurrent_streams` per upstream connection to avoid head-of-line blocking 3) rotate affected edge nodes (drain+recreate) — will take ~3m per node.
Dinesh (Eng): I'll push a temporary ingress tweak: increase `stream_window` and bump upstream `conn_pool_size` from 500 -> 1200 to help while we mitigate.
Carla (Infra): prefer draining and restarting two nodes first to free sockets — rolling restart started on edge-02.
infra-bot: Deploy event: ingress-config/edge-stream-pool-tilt applied by dinesh at 2025-07-21T09:08:00Z
Ben (Eng-SRE): also adding a per-tenant payload size cap in WAF to tell client to chunk batches (suggested workaround to customer: batch_size <= 100).
Alice (Support): sent customer the workaround and ETA for full fix. customer accepted batch_size workaround for now :thumbsup:
Dinesh (Eng): after restart, error rate dropped from 18% -> 2% across affected region. still a few 502s tied to very large single requests.
Ben (Eng-SRE): root cause hypothesis: long-lived large request bodies + h2 multiplexing exhaustion on ingress leading to upstream resets. Need long-term: 1) autoscale ingest paths by request size 2) enforce client chunking 3) improve h2 pool eviction heuristics.
Carla (Infra): creating infra ticket INFRA-2042 to track permanent fixes and config hardening.
Alice (Support): update ticket to customer. will close once 24h stable and monitoring shows no regressions. thanks team :sparkles:
